title: Consolidate per-vertex part/body correspondence evaluation
description: AppearanceBake and implicit-surface influence-domain resolution independently evaluate the same generated vertices against the same Body and resolved part SDF programs. Design one authoritative correspondence result or reusable evaluation pass that can supply nearest-body/part ownership to both consumers without changing tie semantics, mirrored-domain rules, or gradient coloring. Measure before/after because this path is a plausible secondary AppearanceBake and binding hotspot. Do not build a generic IR or service layer merely for abstraction; keep the result specific to generated-surface correspondence.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Current-head static audit 2026-09-12: GenerateData already carries compiled part programs and a Body program, but AppearanceBake and InfluenceDomainResolution remain separate consumers that re-evaluate nearest part/body distances over the same vertices. This is a concrete consolidation/performance opportunity after behavior is locked down by parity tests.
